_comment: Merge these into your Claude Code settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json for
all projects, or .claude/settings.json inside one repo).
Together these mean nobody starts or stops a timer by hand:
SessionStart  resumes whatever you were last doing in this directory, or
the task named by your git branch. Silent if there is
nothing to resume, so unrelated repos stay quiet.
PostToolUse   keeps the session alive while you work. The CLI throttles
this to one real call every two minutes; the rest cost a
SessionEnd    closes the session when you quit, so time stops counting.
All three are safe when nothing is running and when Relay is unreachable:
they exit 0 either way and never interrupt your session.
